channel.title: Apaleo incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Apaleo's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: We are currently investigating an issue affecting our platform. [resolved]
item.description: Systems have been stable and working correctly for over 1 hour. We continue monitoring.

item.title: Intermittent login failures via Single Sign-On (SSO) [resolved]
item.description: Between 11:10 and 11:35 UTC (13:10–13:35 CEST), some users may have experienced errors when signing in via SSO. The issue was intermittent and affected only SSO-based authentication. Sign-ins using other authentication methods were not impacted and continued to work normally. The problem has since been resolved, and SSO login is now operating as expected. Users who were affected should now be able to log in without issue. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: Investigating performance issue on rate plan pricing [resolved]
item.description: An update was deployed that has improved the performance.

item.title: We are currently investigating an issue affecting our platform. [resolved]
Night Audit Processing Delays for Some Accounts [resolved]
Night Audit Processing Delays for Some Accounts [resolved]
item.description: All pending night audits have now been successfully processed, and systems are operating normally. Our team will continue to monitor to ensure stability.

item.title: Webhooks and Payments delayed [resolved]
item.description: We experienced an infrastructure failover on a backend system, the issue has been resolved and delayed processing has been caught up.

item.title: Webhooks and Payments are experiencing delays [resolved]
item.description: All systems are working nominally, any webhook delays cleared.

item.title: Transient authorization issues [resolved]
item.description: A transient issue affecting both the UI and API layers resulted in incorrect permission-related messages being returned. The issue was resolved.

item.title: A smaller technical issue with GET /finance/v1/folios [resolved]
item.description: We experienced a technical issue with GET /finance/v1/folios endpoint that has now been resolved.

item.title: UI and API perfomance degradation and occasional timeouts [resolved]
Folio payments are facing delays in processing [resolved]
Webhook Delivery Latency - Partial Degradation [resolved]
item.description: Webhook delivery performance has returned to normal, and the vast majority of events are now processing on time. We consider this incident resolved, but our team will continue to monitor the system to ensure sustained stability.

item.title: Users have problems to log in again after resetting their passwords [resolved]
